decisions.reason: As a training offer that builds directly on the firm's established service capabilities and customer support strategy, management is likely to continue it despite limited recent visibility because it fits the announced direction and can be justified as part of a broader solutions package.

This accessory had only limited website visibility, likely required comparatively modest sunk investment, and is easier to abandon when results disappoint because management has made only a weak public commitment to it.

Because it is distant from the firm's established offer, was only briefly mentioned, and appears peripheral to the firm's core announced path, management has less reason to escalate commitment and is more likely to redeploy resources elsewhere.

A high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's core business, likely absorbed substantial development resources, and represents a visible strategic commitment that management would be inclined to defend and continue.

The automatic tool change system builds on the firm's installed base and automation direction, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough investment and public commitment for management to persist with it rather than exit quickly.
